rv.q: Despite dreading the show, I’m still glad I went.
The Ford/Hill Project is important theater lest we forget and it happens next time.
But if it's well done—and Ford/Hill, co-created by Elizabeth Marvel and Lee Sunday Evans, certainly is—it's undeniably captivating.
Regardless of your political leanings, this Project will knock you and give you lots to think about once you recover.
In Evans' stripped-down production, which relies entirely on the unbelievable truth, they remain riveting and dismaying in equal measure.
This production of The Ford/Hill Project delivers one forceful, telling moment after another.
The material is both fascinating and deliberately infuriating.

cn.t: Critics praise this riveting verbatim drama weaving the Hill and Blasey Ford testimonies as captivating and searing, though some find the documentary format's foregone conclusions less compelling than its powerful portrait of women confronting power.
